title: First Fast
mainIdea: Perseverance, faith, and self-discipline helped Asma successfully complete her first Ramadan fast and celebrate her achievement.

pages.text: Asma decided to fast for the first time during Ramadan.

question.text: Who is the main character in the story?

pages.text: Asma wanted to complete her first Ramadan fast with her family.

options: To complete her first Ramadan fast

pages.text: Asma became hungry during the day because she could not eat until after sunset.
Asma continued fasting every day and followed the Ramadan traditions with her family.

question.text: What did Asma do to solve the problem?
options: She stopped fasting and ate lunch at school with her friends
She continued fasting and followed the Ramadan practices
She skipped school and slept at home until the sun went down

pages.text: At the end of Ramadan, Asma celebrated Eid al-Fitr with her family and felt proud for completing her first fast.

options: Asma gave up fasting before the last week of Ramadan ended
Asma celebrated Eid al-Fitr and felt proud of herself
Asma stayed home alone while her family celebrated Eid al-Fitr
